topics.question: 多字段用户、广告、上下文与多反馈历史应组织为怎样的表示单元，才能支持有效的联合建模？
topics.hypothesis: 字段、事件、行为组或学习槽位的粒度会改变语义保留和后续交互；通过表示替换、分组与容量控制检验其价值。

decisions.reason: Continue representation research around the provisional linear-moment result: validation macro AUC 0.828326 exceeds zero, copy and quadratic controls by 0.000756, 0.000444 and 0.000261 at identical parameter count. All four tasks improve AUC and Logloss versus the shared reference and topic entry; buy AUC nevertheless falls 0.000128 versus zero moments. Linear uses 32,948,357 parameters and 31.36 s inference versus baseline 32,059,429 and 26.61 s; its training trial cost 406.31 s. Prioritize repeat confirmation and controlled attribution of order information versus redundant content or optimization effects. One seed does not establish mechanism. The existing relation/count merge remains below its stronger frozen source, so compatibility is unresolved and does not justify another merge now.

topics.hypothesis: 先汇聚再交互、逐层联合交互、并行交换或路由结构具有不同的信息瓶颈；依据诊断选择机制，允许完整重写网络，并与最接近的结构比较。

topics.title: Compatibility of representation construction and sequence-field interaction
topics.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, does combining the committed g0 representation approach with the g1 interaction approach improve validation four-task macro ROC-AUC over both frozen source bests, particularly g0 at 0.8301982212762624, at justified parameter and measured compute cost?
topics.hypothesis: Inherit the two committed source approaches, subject to implementation inspection in the next phase. The adaptive/uniform and rotation contrast observed in g1 may retain useful information on g0's stronger representation, but representation changes may already capture that information or introduce interference. Source replacement/factorial and matched-capacity controls, followed by repetition, must distinguish complementary utility from extra capacity and optimization effects. A repeatable gain over both frozen source bests with justified measured cost would support compatibility; failure to exceed the stronger source, or gains reproduced by capacity controls, would oppose added utility for the tested implementation. Source gains are not additive, and repeated seeds alone do not identify a mechanism. Use validation for selection, then freeze the comparison suite before one withheld assessment; do not use withheld outcomes to revise the topic.

Inherit only the committed source approaches after inspection in the implementation phase. Compact aggregation may preserve useful information on the newer g0 representation while reducing aggregation cost, but shared ancestry may make it redundant and the weaker buy result may transfer. Cross source-representation replacement with aggregation replacement, using both frozen source bests as utility controls and matched-capacity/compute controls for attribution. Predict a macro-AUC gain above 0.831886841754755 with measured acceptable cost; failure to beat the stronger source falsifies the proposed utility for that implementation. Track every task's AUC and Logloss, especially buy, without adding a per-task veto. Capacity, optimization and selection variation remain alternative explanations. Stage only controls, authorized repetition and assessment that fit the remaining 2328s; single-seed gains remain provisional and same-seed reproduction is not independent mechanism support. Freeze selection before any permitted held-out assessment.

decisions.reason: Merge g0-t000 and g1-t000: their frozen bests gain +0.020275 and +0.009309 validation four-task macro ROC-AUC over their common baseline/entry. The current topic's adaptive-minus-uniform contrast is +0.004129 for terminal and +0.000742 for rotated, a provisional interaction of +0.003387; this motivates testing transfer to g0's stronger representation, not assuming additive gains. Other merges add only +0.000525 and +0.001116 over their entries, reinforcing compatibility uncertainty. g0 improves all task AUCs and loglosses; g1 improves all AUCs but worsens click logloss by 0.000316. Keep both frozen bests, especially g0 at 0.830198, as utility controls. Source costs are 33,022,405/32,115,012 parameters and 37.64/33.07 inference seconds; current factorial trials took 844-856 seconds each. Within 19,887.5 remaining seconds, reserve resources for source replacement/factorial controls, matched capacity, measured training/inference cost, repetition, and frozen assessment. Failure to exceed g0, or an advantage explained by capacity/cost, opposes added utility. Compact single-seed summaries do not establish mechanisms or novelty; implementation details remain uninspected.

These single-seed contrasts provisionally favor count dependence, not a centering mechanism or confirmed complementarity. Retain both frozen source bests as replacement controls, distinguish inherited utility from added capacity, and measure training/inference cost. Current best uses 32,964,809 parameters and 31.88s inference versus the standalone count-shrink source at 32,288,965 parameters and 24.29s; it trails newer feedback factorization by 0.001903 AUC while using 31.88s versus 36.95s inference. Repeatable gains over source and capacity controls would support continuation; disappearance under those controls would oppose it. All tasks improve AUC/logloss over DIN; favorite AUC slightly regresses versus entry despite improved logloss, and buy regresses versus count shrink. These trade-offs limit the utility claim.

No mechanism or novelty is established by the present summaries.
